body: Hello! I had a question about my application. I submitted some documents last month but haven't heard back. By the way, I wanted to mention that I'm a non-smoker and I don't drink alcohol — I hope that helps with the health assessment. In my free time I mostly cook and go hiking, so I'd say I have a pretty healthy lifestyle. Oh, and please contact me by email, not phone. I work in an open office and can't take personal calls during the day. My email is maria.garcia@email.com. Thanks!
